brief.title: Election update: Sunday, November 8 (morning)
brief.markdown:
# Election update: Sunday, November 8 (morning)

## Bottom line
No race was newly marked called overnight. The House results table stands at 418 of 435 races called: D 256, R 162, with 218 needed for a majority ([House table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_House_of_Representatives_elections)). In the Senate, Democrats have secured 54 seats to Republicans' 44, counting seats not up, with 51 needed ([Senate table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_Senate_elections)). Alaska and Mississippi are still uncalled. FL-27 has officially gone to a recount ([Florida Politics](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE1ncUVFOUhGUXplR1g0bXBSS05qclVyenA3MnRpbTRvcU1qanVPcDY5dkpSeHV4T1BwUHdJZ0htRGtuRjJTVGhqSDA3QldSM2YwamZobVdxRHg0TU1WQTM2c1o3VDJYWmJYdmc?oc=5)). No seat rated safe is within 5 points.

## Called since the last update
- No race was newly marked called in the results table, and no call was reversed.

## Still uncalled
One line for every competitive race the table hasn't marked called, Senate first.
- **AK Senate** (Tossup): the New York Post reports President Trump declared the race "over" for the Republican; that is the president's claim, and no call or official result supports it in today's leads ([NY Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxNcVdtOTlRVEVDMzFCQUhHREt4UkF1UHF3VElMUExxa0Z3NDJVZE9NYlNVbmp1cXdLeGRzZGhJdEhXTXZzdjRacElfRU9Kc1E3OVpBVUJyUVB5R0VPYWYydlBUbnRKSG9xMFQxbDdTYjBhYy1QdmNDWFBrNEtWTmh5MGlWQQ?oc=5)). Mary Peltola's (D) campaign has sued the state for the names of rejected absentee voters ([Alaska Beacon](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxOa3Y0MGV5dFVNMWlrQ0RHdnFNMUVNMndTbTI5TE1QRUhzTkNrOFlGQ2NMOGtSUWFQVWN3YlpnN2stQTFlay1vVWZwQUt3SkVENndyQllEQTdyRkV4VjVORXc5UXBUd3FubWtkRlRsYUhNckFMTlpERjZZdGh3NG92azB4ajd4S1p4LWNpVHpYZG1aU0dIcWFSUnNPUFVSV1F4M1NkcDUwUlRmZ2phUDF1Z0s1X2p1VHp1VFQwSzVR?oc=5)).
- **MS Senate** (Likely R): MS NOW reported Friday that Democrat Scott Colom's lead had widened ([MS NOW](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE9iNUpNaEtQUVI0RDBjdkdSQndjZmI4V0doZ3ZrbUNtb0E2RVNiNDdVSHVmblgzUE5VeFcwSWY1SXZLeW9rbmpvT3g4MkNjb3U3ZVlHRmpCNHV5aGozN2NwMTFhcGhxeVcxMVpMM2ttZzF0SERvT2VSMzdYcVY4TTA?oc=5)); PBS reports the count is stretching on ([PBS](https://news.google.?oc=5)).
- **AK-AL** (Lean R): still on CBS News's list of races without a winner ([CBS](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPTm1vVUVNdk1FNWRfMFlpenMya2pETU00SkhBNGFQOTJGSTlKTDYyTmRLZElSd0ZfOU9oTW83aE5IZnN3SjZPVmZpQ2NuVUZGWTE1bzFMVHpmMDhNQU5uOGV4MGlERlRoeWJ0bG5RcmtaOG1GLUdQS05nN3pVanBtS1BaMHhCc21mS0gtcA?oc=5)).
- **AZ-02** (Lean R): Eli Crane (R) continues to lead Jonathan Nez (D), per the [Arizona Daily Sun](https://news.google.?oc=5).
- **CO-04** (Lean R): Lauren Boebert's (R) campaign expects a recount, per [KDVR](https://news.google.?oc=5); the NYT describes a close race ([NYT](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxQX2Y5ZmFsbnJlLVBjQ3dPMkJDZktUS1RMOEtSVm5rdkhONVVKaGduZUQ0LUw4LXQxaTFFeFl5WkFVZzlHa0JtYkdxd2JpdEtTWmIzMnh2RHpVOWhrZ1JFLXVvc3d0Q19OTm1Bc0ZBaXp4MEEyazFDZDUwWVZzNDRpSnc2TDB1QUhEOG9MZ2tPQmNXYWZs?oc=5)).
- **FL-07** (Lean R): Ryan Elijah (R) has claimed victory before an official call, per [WESH](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxQSXRqU2lpZE9JV2Vkb245ZHNSYnEwNnZEcGNtMVllYzRXZE8taWNjNXlYbGF1NVctbUxmSjJZSTlNMm9KdURJamtlOXY1UmEzSTBEZ20zM2dOTzZLWmhGSnN3aGc0bUxpc0ppWk5FNlNmc0JoUW51NVZSVTdFcC0zYXRmM3E1b2o0SzZpWkJRQUU2N0dEd2F3dWs1amF6SElzTXNsUy1BRWcwQk90STM0UWVxYw?oc=5).
- **FL-27** (Lean R): an automatic machine recount is under way, with Eliott Rodriguez (D) pushing for the county election chief's recusal, per [WPLG](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxPb1ExZkYzNWhhRnVZelhKWVhjb0ZHRGIwaDNvaFJrV3A4ZFlmMWJjY0Y2dzJUSTFBRzBZcVlqcGotSjFqMnp6eGdNUzBhM3NHT0xDU21IOUtBNFNsM25ORnVZVTQ5eXp0VnVybkdJLW9MeGpCY193TnNXYUIyYjJLZjZ6andlaU1PQ2ltaG8tNTl3MVlWeXNXcnItcDljdVRYTFgzZUtzSHN6ejJzQ2lrcDlYekVhdHhXMnh6dzNEMG9adXVKNll5d2xR?oc=5).
- **MN-01** (Lean R): the AP call is still pending, per [KTTC](https://news.google.?oc=5); Brad Finstad (R) is awaiting the recount, per [5 Eyewitness News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxOamtpdHZTUHRRaWxrbVM0NzUzNWkzdnpmT25yZTdVX0xpcWVCMFU4SVNUZXJrUTMxRzM1VVdLQ1BtN05sWEcyOUdaNmRqaE9jWFluRENDRHlCUGI2NjZjWDQtMERRMVpQRGV4RTJZRkloNUh5dlFhcllrZmp0QUZrNGxEMXh4ZTlkd1lqM19nMkoyZjlJdkZzb1c4dGVrZV90bnUtZzZkVXdXVnh3WEE?oc=5).
- **NC-03** (Likely R): Greg Murphy (R) leads by 233 votes as counties prepare to finalize results, per [Neuse News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxQY0syZkI3ZExkcEtTbWROS2dPYkV5S1dKOHBHd21ZRzI5ZnNRTS1tTnNQOVJsYllSQWtnbUgtemhxQ0dDNHFTTlJwX0xnSEtQNXRFa0ZPQUN3cUlsQUtzWF9NaFhBd19yQ1pPbG15VUY0Q2l2QnpHZUx4NG94dTFOUHAycmZEdU94YXNWZGpteUltRFdKcEtaMUtibGFkMzllSXlLeGszbGtycXJ2NjRYbjV2bDZkOXZGd2kzbUpn?oc=5).
- **NC-05** (Likely R): Guilford County officials outlined next steps with Chuck Hubbard (D) holding a 99-vote lead over Virginia Foxx (R), per [WXLV](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxONUMzdFRDVXVCaVVGNGN2UW5aSU15Q3FCZFJpSTF6S1hqUlZadV9fZ2FqeDhmRGVSZV8waDQ4S3RneWJidGhMLVdDbXdBdHpiY1VYb0xFVXYzTV8zcUVGb2dmNGdXbWVYZFo5NjE5LVlLS0pmN2Nzcl9ENWZHVG9EdkVKWVpnblVaNkhjVTVDU2tIelJxYV9ZVmh0bGJLRTNUV1hpNlpSRmtLa1dxSkx4alpHLTlZekYy?oc=5).
- **NC-07** (Likely R): count under way; no fresh lead ([results table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_House_of_Representatives_elections)).
- **WA-05** (Likely R): The Spokesman-Review reports Michael Baumgartner (R) held on to win a second term ([Spokesman-Review](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijwFBVV95cUxOTnVJUEZtRlZMWG9LeWNlTjM4NXRJcnU5dmhqNS10ZE9JRFZhTHlQZklDYjRpS2laZkkzZHVLMVprRXdYdnhCYnFfdHQ3RU53bHQ1UVJwQnB6TzhGWktNZ3hoa1o0Q0NMWi1wdllPeUtlcmJuVTl2eC1WLUNzODlzSXF3VGViMnQ5bEF0VWRMdw?oc=5)); no AP call is cited and the table has not marked it, so it is not counted here.
- **Safe seats:** 7 seats rated safe are not yet marked in the table. That is table lag, not close races ([full list](https://jakeworcester-byte.github.io/political-tracker/#results)).

## Recounts and certification
- **Florida:** FL-27 is officially in a recount ([Florida Politics](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE1ncUVFOUhGUXplR1g0bXBSS05qclVyenA3MnRpbTRvcU1qanVPcDY5dkpSeHV4T1BwUHdJZ0htRGtuRjJTVGhqSDA3QldSM2YwamZobVdxRHg0TU1WQTM2c1o3VDJYWmJYdmc?oc=5)).
- **Minnesota:** MN-01's AP call is pending while Finstad seeks a recount ([KTTC](https://news.google.?oc=5)).
- **North Carolina:** Guilford County outlined the next steps in NC-05 ([WXLV](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxONUMzdFRDVXVCaVVGNGN2UW5aSU15Q3FCZFJpSTF6S1hqUlZadV9fZ2FqeDhmRGVSZV8waDQ4S3RneWJidGhMLVdDbXdBdHpiY1VYb0xFVXYzTV8zcUVGb2dmNGdXbWVYZFo5NjE5LVlLS0pmN2Nzcl9ENWZHVG9EdkVKWVpnblVaNkhjVTVDU2tIelJxYV9ZVmh0bGJLRTNUV1hpNlpSRmtLa1dxSkx4alpHLTlZekYy?oc=5)).
- **Colorado:** the Boebert campaign expects a recount in CO-04 ([KDVR](https://news.google.?oc=5)).

## Legal and federal action
- **Florida:** the Miami Herald reports Rodriguez sued to remove Miami-Dade's election chief from the FL-27 recount ([Miami Herald](https://news.google.?oc=5)).
